title: Golden Years
description: A modpack made to replicate the experience of the golden years of minecraft!
body:
# ABOUT THE MODPACK

Golden Years uses Nostalgic Tweaks and other mods to faithfully recreate the feel of older versions of Minecraft: Java Edition, while keeping the quality-of-life features and performance improvements of modern Minecraft.

# HOW TO INSTALL

Modrinth (Recommended)

The easiest way! Just download the version you want with a few clicks.

Prism Launcher

Prefer more control? Use Prism Launcher! Head to the Modrinth section and search for Golden Years.

# FEATURES

Golden Years includes:

    ⚡ Great Performance

    ✅ Free Multiplayer

    🎨 Legacy Resource Pack Support

    🌍 Dedicated Golden Years Server

    🖥️ Optimized for the Best Performance Possible

# Special Thanks

A huge shout-out to Adrenix, the creator of Legacy Tweaks, the foundation this entire project is built upon!

# FAQ

Can I play on any multiplayer server?
Yes! I’ve even played on Hypixel—anti-cheat systems won’t ban you.

Why use this modpack if I can just play the old betas?
Because this modpack brings back the nostalgic look and feel while keeping modern features and improvements. The best of both worlds!

Is there a community server for this modpack?
Yes! Join us on [Jayden's Wacky Saturday](https://discord.gg/AsJK8rwJXR).
